mapper.sql: SELECT t.store_idx AS storeIdx, t.tag_uid AS tagUid, CAST(t.use_yn AS VARCHAR) AS useYn, t.registered_at AS registeredAt, t.registered_by AS registeredBy FROM store_nfc_tag t
mapper.select: SELECT sm.store_idx AS storeIdx, sm.store_nm AS storeNm, cm.code_nm AS brandNm, sm.latitude AS latitude, sm.longitude AS longitude, t.tag_uid AS tagUid FROM store_nfc_tag t INNER JOIN store_mst sm ON sm.store_idx = t.store_idx LEFT JOIN code_mst cm ON sm.brand_cd = cm.code_cd AND cm.grp_cd = 40 WHERE t.tag_uid = #{tagUid} AND COALESCE(t.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store_nfc_tag (store_idx, tag_uid, use_yn, registered_by) VALUES (#{storeIdx}, #{tagUid}, 'Y', #{registeredBy}) ON CONFLICT (store_idx) DO UPDATE SET tag_uid = EXCLUDED.tag_uid, use_yn = 'Y', registered_at = now(), registered_by = EXCLUDED.registered_by
